before: A section whose footnotePr or endnotePr omitted numFmt resolved its format from settings.xml, so a chicago document-wide format numbered every later section's notes in symbols.
after: Such a section resolves to the default format; the document-wide format applies only to a section with no note properties of its own.
reason: Only how resolved note properties are read changes. The authored properties, shared state, operations, snapshots and protocol messages are untouched.
